description: mod-ncip deployment configuration template (see ADR-0013, Module configuration management).

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the mod-ncip container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the mod-ncip container (MiB)

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the mod-ncip container (MiB)

deployment.description: mod-ncip is stateless (no database) and supports multiple replicas. Adjust replicas based on expected NCIP request volume.

kong.description: Read timeout set to 120s, above the 30s service_manager_timeout_ms, so slow NCIP responses are not cut off.

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Name of the deployment environment.

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: JVM options carrying the module's system properties: port, log level and the timeout in milliseconds for calls to FOLIO APIs; use a different port than the sidecar's 8081 when deployed with a sidecar.

java.name: UseZGC
java.description: Use the low-pause ZGC garbage collector

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Name of the deployment environment.

EnvVars.name: MODULE_NAME
EnvVars.description: Name of the backend module this sidecar fronts.

EnvVars.name: MODULE_VERSION
EnvVars.description: Version of the mod-ncip module deployed alongside this sidecar.

EnvVars.name: MODULE_URL
EnvVars.description: Internal URL at which the mod-ncip container is reachable from its sidecar.

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTS
EnvVars.description: Additional JVM options for the sidecar process, with heap and GC settings supplied separately.

EnvVars.name: SIDECAR_MODULE_PATH_PREFIX_STRATEGY
EnvVars.description: How the module path prefix is handled when forwarding requests to the module.

EnvVars.name: SIDECAR_FORWARD_UNKNOWN_REQUESTS
EnvVars.description: Forwards requests the sidecar does not recognise to the gateway.

EnvVars.name: SIDECAR_FORWARD_UNKNOWN_REQUESTS_DESTINATION
EnvVars.description: Gateway URL that unrecognised requests are forwarded to.

EnvVars.name: ALLOW_CROSS_TENANT_REQUESTS
EnvVars.description: Allows requests that cross tenant boundaries.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Type of secret store the sidecar reads credentials from.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_REGION
EnvVars.description: AWS region of the SSM secret store, used when SECRET_STORE_TYPE is AWS_SSM.

EnvVars.name: KC_URL
EnvVars.description: Base URL of Keycloak.

EnvVars.name: KC_SERVICE_CLIENT_ID
EnvVars.description: Keycloak client ID the sidecar uses for module access.

EnvVars.name: KC_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID
EnvVars.description: Keycloak client ID used for admin operations.

EnvVars.name: KC_LOGIN_CLIENT_SUFFIX
EnvVars.description: Suffix appended to the tenant name to form the Keycloak login client ID.

EnvVars.name: KC_URI_VALIDATION_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables validation of redirect URIs in Keycloak.

EnvVars.name: KC_AUTHORIZATION_CACHE_MAX_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of Keycloak authorization results cached, in entries.

EnvVars.name: TOKEN_CACHE_MAX_CAPACITY
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of tokens cached, in entries.

EnvVars.name: TOKEN_CACHE_REFRESH_PRIOR_EXPIRATION
EnvVars.description: Seconds before expiry at which a cached token is refreshed.

EnvVars.name: AM_CLIENT_URL
EnvVars.description: URL of the mgr-applications service.

EnvVars.name: TM_CLIENT_URL
EnvVars.description: URL of the mgr-tenants service.

EnvVars.name: TE_CLIENT_URL
EnvVars.description: URL of the mgr-tenant-entitlements service.

EnvVars.name: MOD_USERS_URL
EnvVars.description: URL of the mod-users service.

EnvVars.name: MOD_USERS_KEYCLOAK_URL
EnvVars.description: URL of the mod-users-keycloak service.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_HOST
EnvVars.description: Kafka bootstrap host.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PORT
EnvVars.description: Kafka bootstrap port.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SECURITY_PROTOCOL
EnvVars.description: Security protocol used to connect to Kafka, for example SSL.

EnvVars.name: REQUEST_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Request timeout in milliseconds applied by the sidecar.

EnvVars.name: QUARKUS_REST_CLIENT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: REST client connect timeout in milliseconds.

EnvVars.name: QUARKUS_REST_CLIENT_READ_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: REST client read timeout in milliseconds.

EnvVars.name: QUARKUS_REST_CLIENT_SEND_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: REST client send timeout in milliseconds.

EnvVars.name: QUARKUS_HTTP_LIMITS_MAX_BODY_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum HTTP request body size accepted by the sidecar.

EnvVars.name: QUARKUS_HTTP_LIMITS_MAX_INITIAL_LINE_LENGTH
EnvVars.description: Maximum length in bytes of the HTTP request line.

EnvVars.name: QUARKUS_VERTX_EVENT_LOOPS_POOL_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Number of Vert.x event loop threads.
